title: Finite products of localization functors
statement: Let $J$ be a finite type, let $C_j,D_j$ be categories [def-nagata-category] for $j\in J$, and let $W_j$ be classes of arrows in $C_j$ containing identities. Let $L_j:C_j\to D_j$ be localizations at $W_j$, in the universal-property sense of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. Then the product functor $\prod_{j\in J}L_j:\prod_{j\in J}C_j\to\prod_{j\in J}D_j$ is a localization at the class of tuples $(w_j)_{j\in J}$ with $w_j\in W_j$ for all $j$.
